_comment: Asset concept specs for the MILLION DEAD pipeline. Coordinates: +Y up, model faces +Z, metres, origin on the ground under the centre. Budgets from shared/specs/mesh_format.md; palette and silhouettes from shared/specs/art_direction.md.

scuttler.emissive_hint: the eye cluster on the front of the wedge head
scuttler.prompt: Ultra low poly faceted alien bug creature, a roach or tick crossed with a machine: a low, wide, flat armoured carapace made of a few large angular chitin plates, a sharp wedge-shaped head pointing forward, exactly four thick angular legs splayed far out to the sides, a pale bone-coloured ridge along the spine, a cluster of glowing orange eyes on the front of the head. Colours: dark graphite grey carapace, gunmetal grey legs, pale bone ridges, glowing orange eyes, nothing else. Large flat planes, hard edges, no small details, no greebles. Standing neutral pose, facing forward, single object, no base, no pedestal, no ground.
scuttler.negative_prompt: pedestal, base, ground plane, humanoid, smooth organic, fur, hair, wires, text, multiple creatures, bright colours

stalker.emissive_hint: the eyes on the front of the head
stalker.prompt: Ultra low poly faceted alien predator, insectoid and mechanical: a hunched, upright-ish body leaning forward, two very long flat blade-shaped forelimbs like scythes held forward and down, two digitigrade reverse-knee legs, a narrow angular head with glowing orange eyes, pale bone-coloured spikes along the hunched back. Colours: dark graphite grey chitin, gunmetal grey joints, pale bone blades and ridges, glowing orange eyes only. Large flat angular planes, hard edges, no greebles. Standing neutral pose, facing forward, single creature, no base, no pedestal, no ground.
stalker.negative_prompt: pedestal, base, ground plane, human, robot, smooth organic, fur, hair, wires, tail, wings, text, bright colours

seeker.emissive_hint: the large lens eye on the front of the body
seeker.prompt: Ultra low poly faceted floating alien drone: a single large round armoured eye body with one big glowing orange lens on the front, surrounded by a flat angular ring and four blade-like fins, no legs, no arms. Colours: dark graphite grey shell, gunmetal grey ring, pale bone fins, glowing orange lens only. Large flat angular planes, hard edges, no greebles. Hovering, facing forward, single object, no base, no pedestal, no ground, no stand.
seeker.negative_prompt: pedestal, base, stand, ground plane, legs, arms, cables, wires, text, bright colours

colossus.emissive_hint: the glowing core in the armoured chest, front
colossus.prompt: Ultra low poly faceted colossal alien siege beast: a massive heavily armoured quadruped with four thick pillar legs, a broad armoured body, a tall stepped siege-tower structure rising from its back, a low armoured head, and a single large glowing red core in its chest. Colours: dark graphite grey armour plates, gunmetal grey legs and tower, pale bone ridges, glowing red core only. Huge flat angular planes, hard edges, no greebles.
